main.description: Builds an ordered feed skeleton from current records indexed for the requested viewer scope. The caller hydrates returned strong references separately.

errors.name: INVALID_REQUEST
errors.description: The request is malformed or semantically invalid.

errors.name: INVALID_VIEWER
errors.description: viewerDid is not a valid DID.

errors.name: AUTHORS_FILTER_TOO_LARGE
errors.description: The authors filter exceeds its supported size.

errors.name: TRUSTED_EVALUATORS_TOO_LARGE
errors.description: The trusted evaluator filter exceeds its supported size.

errors.name: FEED_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE
errors.description: The resolved author scope exceeds its supported size.

errors.name: INVALID_KIND
errors.description: The request contains an unsupported event kind.

errors.name: INVALID_CURSOR
errors.description: The cursor is invalid or incompatible.

errors.name: INTERNAL_ERROR
errors.description: The service encountered an internal error.

viewerDid.description: Viewer whose Certified follows supply the default author scope.

authors.description: Optional replacement for the viewer's direct-follow author set. An explicitly empty array selects no base authors.

trustedEvaluators.description: Evaluator DIDs whose active endorsement subjects extend the author scope.

limit.description: Maximum number of skeleton items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor returned by a previous request.

kinds.description: Final event kinds to include. Omitted or empty means every supported kind.

schema.description: Returns ordered feed skeleton items with exact record references and an optional cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted when no later page is known.

organizationQualityPolicy.description: Controls which known organizations qualify before event pagination.

allowed.description: Organization quality values allowed into the feed.

includeUnrated.description: Whether known organizations without an active trusted quality label qualify.

feedSkeletonItem.description: One classified feed event represented by its exact indexed record version.
